feedback: The test cases adequately cover the requirement to accept expressions with or without spaces between numbers and operators. Test R007-T01 validates minimal expressions with no spaces (e.g., '2+3'). Test R007-T02 includes a mixed expression with spaces and no spaces, testing parsing robustness and left-to-right evaluation of addition and subtraction. Test R007-T03 evaluates division with left-to-right application, confirming precedence and parsing under no-space conditions. All tests align with the stated intent, use valid inputs, and are directly tied to the requirement. Mathematical reference checks are not needed as the examples are simple and verifiable by hand. Coverage is sufficient and justified.
